Questions

Frequently Asked

What areas do you serve?
Farmington, Jay, Wilton, Rangeley, Kingfield, New Sharon, Strong, Phillips, Carrabassett Valley, Chesterville, Industry, Eustis and all of Franklin County, Maine.
What services do you offer?
Lawn mowing, landscaping, mulching, patios & hardscaping, excavation, home improvements, spring & fall cleanups and winter snow removal — one crew, year-round.
Do you offer free quotes?
Yes. Call or text (207) 491-5054 with what you need and we'll give you an honest, up-front quote.
Are you locally owned?
Yes — CWB Lawn Care & Landscaping is owned and operated by Christian Whitney, serving Franklin County.
Do you do snow removal in the winter?
Absolutely. We provide dependable snow removal and plowing for driveways and properties across Franklin County all winter.
